title: 2020 Panini Contenders Green Explosion #3 Chris Paul Golden State Warriors Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This Chris Paul 2020 Panini Contenders Game Ticket sports trading card is a must-have for any basketball fan. Featuring the NBA star in action, the card showcases a Green Explosion parallel/variety, adding to its collectible value. The card is part of the 2020 Panini Contenders set and has been assigned the card number #3.

The card is in great condition and will be shipped securely to ensure its safe arrival. Own a piece of basketball history with this Chris Paul sports trading card, perfect for any collector or fan.
